# Coolment’s Cobblemon Crew Pack

The _official_ **Coolment Cobblemon SMP** pack for **Coolment** and his community, packed with quality-of-life, performance, and Pokémon content

---

### Core Pokémon Mods

* [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/MdwFAVRL), [Cobblenav](https://modrinth.com/mod/bI8Nt3uA), [Cobbreeding](https://modrinth.com/mod/ItmVb4zY)
* [Cobblemon Battle Tower](https://modrinth.com/mod/v19DG9nW), [Cobblemon: Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/SszvX85I)
* [Radical Common Trainers](https://modrinth.com/mod/lRwTUnD7) (+ [API](https://modrinth.com/mod/CBfM2yw7), [Wild Battle API](https://modrinth.com/mod/v7VZE8kh))
* Extras: [Cobbled Gacha](https://modrinth.com/mod/c1OpnQs3), [SimpleTMs](https://modrinth.com/mod/yFqR0DNc), [Safe Pastures](https://modrinth.com/mod/qpe01spE), [Pokeblocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/hnOfcjSq), [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/BAscRYKm), [CobbleFurnies](https://modrinth.com/mod/AXY1OO9m) (+ [Depends](https://modrinth.com/mod/b1ZV3DIJ)), [Cobblemon Pokemon Badges](https://modrinth.com/mod/pPldOOeY), [Badge Box](https://modrinth.com/mod/8J7TR166), [Cobblemon Economy](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfVCrbFk)

---

### Performance & Optimization

* Core: [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/AANobbMI), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/gvQqBUqZ), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/uXXizFIs), [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/fQEb0iXm)
* Sodium Addons: [Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/PtjYWJkn), [Leaf Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/M25bkObt), [Shadowy Path Blocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/EIa1eiMm), [Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/Es5v4eyq), [Reese's Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/Bh37bMuy)
* Other: [EntityCulling](https://modrinth.com/mod/NNAgCjsB), [Clumps](https://modrinth.com/mod/Wnxd13zP)

---

### Visuals & Effects

* Lighting: [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/yBW8D80W)
* Effects: [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/rI0hvYcd), [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/nrikgvxm), [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/WhbRG4iK), [Make Bubbles Pop](https://modrinth.com/mod/gPCdW0Wr)
* Models & Animations: [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/4I1XuqiY), [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/BVzZfTc1), [NotEnoughAnimations](https://modrinth.com/mod/MPCX6s5C)
* UI: [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/Wq5SjeWM)

---

### Quality-of-Life

* Info: [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/fRiHVvU7) (+ [Enchanting](https://modrinth.com/mod/wbWoo11W), [Ores](https://modrinth.com/mod/sG4TqDb8), [Professions](https://modrinth.com/mod/LGVihYcz)), [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/nvQzSEkH), [Just Enough Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/EO27GKs1), [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/EsAfCjCV)
* Controls: [Better Third Person](https://modrinth.com/mod/G1s2WpNo), [Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/ZcR9weSm), [Enhanced Attack Indicator](https://modrinth.com/mod/eTy17BBS), [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/aC3cM3Vq), [SwingThrough](https://modrinth.com/mod/JyKlunuD)
* Interaction: [Crafting Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/DMu0oBKf), [Tree Harvester](https://modrinth.com/mod/abooMhox), [Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/EltpO5cN) (+ [Cobblemon Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/mod/ywwXJDli)), [Let Me Despawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/vE2FN5qn), [NetherPortalFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/nPZr02ET)

---

[Open Parties and Claims](https://modrinth.com/mod/gF3BGWvG), [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/9eGKb6K1), [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/qQyHxfxd), [Chat Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/MOqt4Z5n), [Better Ping Display](https://modrinth.com/mod/MS1ZMyR7)
